parsed.modern: on the brink of the craft side. The fore-ground (a a) of the figure is one division of the crater. Beyond it are two eminences b and c, higher than that on which some human figures are represented. All the three form a triangle nearly equilateral; but, when viewed from any considerable distance, only two of them can be seen; for which reason the Sicilians have termed the mountain bicorne, or double-horned.
